data.name: customSqlQuery3.Sql
data.value: select "LoginAttempts"."Id", "LoginAttempts"."Username", "LoginAttempts"."UserId", "LoginAttempts"."IsSuccessful", "LoginAttempts"."FailureReason", "LoginAttempts"."IpAddress", "LoginAttempts"."UserAgent", "LoginAttempts"."AttemptDate", "LoginAttempts"."LoginType", "AspNetUsers"."Id" as "AspNetUsers_Id", "AspNetUsers"."FullNameEN", "AspNetUsers"."FullNameAR" from ("dbo"."LoginAttempts" "LoginAttempts" left join "dbo"."AspNetUsers" "AspNetUsers" on ("AspNetUsers"."Id" = "LoginAttempts"."UserId")) order by Id desc
